title: Online shopping & delivery app (frontend: storefront, cart, checkout, orders, tracking)

requirements.summary: Add Internet Identity sign-in/out, authenticated session state, and require auth for order creation flows.
acceptanceCriteria: A user can sign in and sign out using Internet Identity.
The UI clearly shows whether the user is signed in (e.g., header state).
All order-creation actions require the user to be signed in (with a clear prompt if not).

file_operations.description: Create the app shell with routing, global layout, and authentication-aware guards for checkout/order placement. Use the selected authorization component’s frontend authentication guidance (Internet Identity + session) to drive signed-in state. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a header login/logout button using useInternetIdentity, and clear cached app data on logout (including react-query cache and cart/session data) per the selected authorization component guidance. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a first-login profile setup modal that prompts for a display name if getCallerUserProfile() returns null, and saves it via saveCallerUserProfile(). Avoid displaying the principal id; show profile name instead (selected authorization component guidance). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add a react-query hook that fetches getCallerUserProfile() and exposes loading state that prevents the profile setup modal flash (per selected authorization component guidance). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add a small auth helper hook that derives isAuthenticated from useInternetIdentity identity, fetches caller role when needed (getCallerUserRole/isCallerAdmin), and provides a consistent English message for unauthorized actions. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Build storefront browsing with product list, search, category filter, and a product detail view.
acceptanceCriteria: Storefront lists products with name, price, and availability.
Search filters products by name (case-insensitive).
Category filter narrows visible products.
Clicking a product opens a detail view with description and price.

file_operations.description: Create react-query hooks to load products from the backend capability (getAllProducts, and optionally local client-side lookup by id for detail view) and normalize loading/error states in English.

Implement the storefront page with search-by-name (case-insensitive), category filter, product cards showing name/price/availability, and links to product detail. Use composed shadcn-ui components (do not edit frontend/src/components/ui) for cards, inputs, and selects. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Implement product detail page showing description, price, availability, and an Add to Cart action. Ensure friendly empty/error states in English when product is missing.
Wire Storefront and Product Detail routes into the router and ensure navigation paths are reachable via header/nav.

requirements.summary: Implement a client-side cart with add/remove/update quantity, session persistence, and order summary.
acceptanceCriteria: User can add items to cart from product list or product detail.
User can change quantities and remove items from cart.
Cart shows subtotal and total item count.
Cart state persists across page navigation within the app session.

file_operations.description: Define cart item types that capture product id, name, unit price, and quantity, aligned with the backend’s LineItem snapshot expectations.
Implement session persistence for cart state using sessionStorage (serialize/deserialize, versioning, and safe error handling).
Create a Cart context/provider with add/remove/update quantity, computed subtotal and item count, and persistence via cartStorage.
Create a hook to access cart actions/selectors from components (items, subtotal, itemCount, clearCart).

Implement Cart page UI with editable quantities, remove controls, subtotal and item count, and a clear English empty state with a call-to-action back to storefront. Use composed shadcn-ui components for forms/buttons. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wire Add to Cart actions from the product list into CartProvider.
Wire Add to Cart action from product detail into CartProvider.
Wrap the routed application with CartProvider and add the Cart route to the router.

requirements.summary: Create a checkout UI to collect delivery address/phone, validate inputs, show summary, place an order, and handle success/error behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Checkout requires non-empty delivery address and contact phone validation with inline error messages.
Submitting checkout creates an order and shows a confirmation screen with the orderId.
After successful order placement, the cart is cleared.
If the backend returns an error, the UI displays an English error message and keeps the cart intact.

file_operations.description: Create a mutation hook that calls the backend capability createOrder(input) using current cart snapshot data, and surfaces friendly English errors for failures (including authorization traps).

Implement checkout form collecting delivery address and contact phone, inline validation, and order summary using cart state. Require sign-in before submission (prompt and link/button to sign in). Use composed shadcn-ui form components; do not edit frontend/src/components/ui. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Implement confirmation screen that displays the returned orderId and provides navigation to My Orders / Order Detail.
Wire Checkout and Order Confirmation routes and add a guard so checkout/order placement is only available when authenticated; ensure cart clearing occurs only on successful order placement.

requirements.summary: Implement order tracking UI with status list and order detail timeline/stepper for defined delivery statuses.
acceptanceCriteria: Each order has one of the defined statuses stored on the backend.
Frontend shows a list of the user’s orders with current status and created date/time.
Order detail view shows a timeline/stepper highlighting the current status.
At least one backend method exists to retrieve a single order by id for the authenticated caller.

file_operations.description: Create hooks to fetch a user’s orders list (authenticated) and to fetch a single order by id (getOrder). Normalize date/time formatting and errors in English.

Create a simple timeline/stepper component that maps backend OrderStatus values to user-friendly English labels (Placed, Preparing, Out for delivery, Delivered, Cancelled) and highlights the current status. Use composed shadcn-ui primitives (do not edit frontend/src/components/ui). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Implement My Orders page showing list of orders with created date/time and current status; include friendly English empty state when none exist.
Implement Order Detail page that loads an order by id, renders delivery/contact info, line items, and the status timeline; handle not-found/unauthorized errors gracefully in English.
Wire My Orders and Order Detail routes into the router and ensure they require authentication to view personal data (show Access Denied / sign-in prompt when unauthenticated).

requirements.summary: Add core navigation and required pages with English-friendly empty/error states and graceful handling for not-found/unauthorized.
acceptanceCriteria: All pages are reachable from a consistent header/navigation.
Cart empty state has a clear call to action to return to the storefront.
My Orders empty state explains that no orders exist yet.
Order not found and unauthorized states are handled gracefully.

file_operations.description: Create a consistent header with navigation links to Storefront, Cart, Checkout, and My Orders; include auth state (signed in name vs signed out) and the logo (wired in REQ-11). Compose shadcn-ui components; do not edit frontend/src/components/ui. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Create a shared layout wrapper applying consistent spacing and placing AppHeader above routed content.

Create a simple screen to show when a user is not signed in (or otherwise unauthorized), with a clear English message and a sign-in call-to-action. Align behavior with the selected authorization component guidance for access control UX. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Create a user-friendly Not Found screen in English with navigation back to Storefront.
Ensure all required routes exist (Storefront, Cart, Checkout, My Orders, Order Detail), all are reachable via header navigation, and add route-level fallbacks for not-found and unauthorized states.

requirements.summary: Apply a cohesive modern grocery/retail delivery visual theme across the app.
acceptanceCriteria: The app uses a consistent theme across header, buttons, cards, and forms.
Pages share consistent layout structure and spacing rules.
User-facing text is in English and consistent in tone and terminology.

file_operations.description: Define/adjust global theme tokens (colors, typography, spacing) and ensure consistent base styles for a modern delivery/grocery feel, staying compatible with Tailwind/shadcn-ui usage and without editing immutable UI component files.
Adjust Tailwind theme configuration (palette/typography/radius/shadows) to match the cohesive warm, modern retail delivery theme used across pages.
Ensure shared layout spacing and content width rules are applied consistently across all pages.

requirements.summary: Wire generated logo and hero illustration from frontend/public/assets/generated into the header and storefront.
acceptanceCriteria: Generated images exist under frontend/public/assets/generated and are referenced by the frontend via static paths.
The logo is displayed in the app header.
A hero illustration is displayed on the storefront/home section without requiring any backend calls.

file_operations.description: Add the generated logo asset at the exact path frontend/public/assets/generated/shop-logo.dim_512x512.png for static serving.
Add the generated hero illustration asset at the exact path frontend/public/assets/generated/store-hero.dim_1600x600.png for static serving.
Render the static logo image from frontend/public/assets/generated/shop-logo.dim_512x512.png in the header.
Render the static hero illustration from frontend/public/assets/generated/store-hero.dim_1600x600.png in a hero section on the storefront page without any backend calls.
